features.name: hive-architect
features.detail: model: opus; tools Read/Glob/Grep/Bash/WebFetch/WebSearch. Strategic designer — ADRs, multi-project impact, implementation plans. Explicitly 'do not write production code'. Output template: Goal / Constraints / Options / Recommendation / Implementation plan / Risks & rollback.

features.name: hive-builder
features.detail: model: sonnet; tools add Write+Edit. Executes architect plans. Hardcodes QI conventions: ports from registry, raw-string Windows paths, encoding=utf-8, NSSM QI_ prefix, logs to <project>\LOGS\. Hands off to hive-inspector after implementing.

features.name: hive-inspector
features.detail: model: sonnet; read-only (Read/Glob/Grep/Bash). 7-point checklist: standards, Five Laws, secrets, match-to-plan, failure modes, backward-compat, tests. Findings tagged [CRITICAL]/[MAJOR]/[MINOR]/[NIT]. Honesty rule from the partnership compact.

features.name: hive-ops
features.detail: model: haiku. Service triage: Get-Service QI_*, nssm restart via gsudo, port-owner lookup, orphan kill (confirm parent first). Reads QI_Service_Registry.md / QI_Ecosystem_Map.md first.

features.name: hive-scout
features.detail: model: haiku; adds WebFetch/WebSearch. Fast research, <300 words, bullet lists, cite every source, lead with the answer. Surfaces options; does not decide.

features.name: hive-scribe
features.detail: model: haiku; adds Write+Edit. Writes .docx session summaries to C:\QIH\shared\documentation\session_summaries\ with <PROJECT>_Summary_YYYY-MM-DD_HHMM.docx; python-docx, Heading 1/2, clickable full-path links.

features.name: hive-tester
features.detail: model: haiku; read-only. Runs pytest/playwright, sweeps /health on every registry port, runs qi_validator.py --project <id>. Never edits tests to pass; reports X/Y with failure context.

features.name: hive-librarian
features.detail: model: sonnet; read-only. Sits on the Documentation Brain (docs + doc_relationships in qi_brain.db, qi_docs Chroma collection). Find / flag-stale / dedupe / enforce-compliance over 936+ docs. Semantic search via Brain API :9011 /api/search_memory; doc_harvester.py --stats.

features.name: Dispatch table + workflows
features.detail: Standing rule, every session. Trigger->agent table; Workflow A (architect->builder->inspector->scribe), B (scout->architect->build/review), C (ops->architect->tester). Anti-patterns: no architect-reasoning in main thread, never bypass inspector, never fake attribution, keep delegation one level deep.

features.name: Session-start verification
features.detail: First action should verify hive agents are loaded by listing sub-agents; agents in both ~/.claude/agents/ and .claude/agents/ should load. If not, flag immediately.

features.name: main() — registry walk
features.detail: Reads C:\QIH\ecosystem\qi_registry.json, calls inspect_project() per project, writes report.json + DASHBOARD.md + feeds QIH status.json. Wraps each project in try/except so one inspector exception becomes a red finding, not a crash.

features.name: inspect_project()
features.detail: Per project: path-exists, git_state, scan_failure_files, list_services_for, scheduled_tasks_for; aggregates findings and computes severity_for() -> red/yellow/green.

features.name: git_state()
features.detail: git status --porcelain (untracked vs modified counts) + git log -1 --format=%cI|%s for last-commit age. >14 days = yellow stale_commits; >5 dirty files = red.

features.name: list_services_for() / scheduled_tasks_for()
features.detail: PowerShell over nssm.exe AppDirectory/Application to find QI_ services rooted under the project; Get-ScheduledTask matched by action path, flags non-zero LastTaskResult (267009 'running' treated as OK).

features.name: render_dashboard() / feed_qih_status()
features.detail: Renders the red/yellow/green summary + findings table to DASHBOARD.md; merges per-project severity, git state, and findings into C:\QIH\data\status.json under projects[name].

features.name: settings.json — hook + permission wiring
features.detail: permissions.defaultMode=bypassPermissions, allow Bash/Read/Write/Edit/Glob/Grep/WebFetch/WebSearch/mcp__*. Hooks: SessionEnd -> session_end.py, SubagentStop -> subagent_stop.py (both via C:\1-AI\APPS\PYTHON\python.exe, 15s timeout).

features.name: SessionEnd auto-stub
features.detail: Reads hook JSON from stdin, infers project from cwd vs registry (longest-prefix; C:\CLAUDE -> claude_manager), pulls a coarse transcript summary, dedups by session_id, writes a session stub to C:\QIH\shared\reports\inbox for QI_HiveIngest. Best-effort, never blocks.

features.name: SubagentStop role attribution
features.detail: Normalises subagent_type to hive_<role> (HIVE_ROLES set), infers project from cwd, writes <agent>_subagent_<ts>_<sid>.json to the Hive inbox so sub-agent work is attributed to the right role in qi_brain.db.

features.name: SessionStart context injection
features.detail: Global hook (not in project settings.json). Builds the ecosystem briefing via qi_context_loader, probes QI Brain (fail-LOUD if down), appends the Hive dispatch reminder + the monthly-audit PENDING_REVIEW gate, and emits hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext. Note: probes :9010 in source while Brain now lives on :9011 — known stale-port nit.

features.name: claude_restart_guard.ps1
features.detail: -Scan/-Clean/-CleanOrphans/-Locks. Builds a kill-set from claude.exe descendant trees + orphaned MCP-signature processes (mcp-server-sqlite, brain/mcp.py, git-mcp, etc.). Is-UnderService excludes services.exe/nssm children so QI_ services are never touched; self-protects its own ancestor chain.

features.name: Claude-Clean-Restart.bat
features.detail: Explorer-launched wrapper: Scan -> choice-gated Clean -> Locks verify -> relaunch Claude via shell:AppsFolder\Claude_pzs8sxrjxfjjc!Claude. No reboot needed.

features.name: qi_self_audit.py
features.detail: Monthly read-only audit + optional --apply-safe. Safe fixes: -CleanOrphans, git worktree prune + remove CLEAN worktrees across 8 repos, prune dead .claude.json worktree entries (with .bak). Reports big folders/temp/backups for decision. Writes .md+.docx + PENDING_REVIEW.json flag.

features.name: Run-Monthly-SelfAudit.ps1
features.detail: QI_ClaudeSelfAudit orchestrator (last Friday). Runs qi_self_audit.py --apply-safe, parses the one-line AUDIT summary, notifies via Tasuke, auto-opens Claude Desktop for the in-session decision gate. Headless via conhost --headless.

features.name: qi_tasuke_notify.py
features.detail: POSTs a LINE broadcast via api.line.me/v2/bot/message/broadcast; token read from C:\OC\secrets\tasuke-line.env (no stored userId). Message capped at 4900 chars.

features.name: brain_reconcile_2026_06_10.py
features.detail: Phase-3 drift fix against C:\QIH\data\qi_brain.db: register new projects (personalsong, m2v) INSERT OR IGNORE, fix stale fields (autopdf path, qi_brain port 9011), refresh project_state for 15 projects, merge bad session IDs (OpenClaw->openclaw), backfill the Naya 05-15 session from git evidence.

features.name: secrets_migration_round2.py
features.detail: Round-2 secrets migration tooling — move hardcoded secrets to env files across the ecosystem.

features.name: maia_env_migration.py / maia_restart_services.py
features.detail: Maia-side environment migration + service restart helpers run from the management workspace.

features.name: gen_qih_overview.py / gen_qih_projects_append.py
features.detail: python-docx generators that build the QI Hive overview + per-project appendix Word documents (Heading styles, tables, colored runs, margins).

features.name: health_check.py
features.detail: Standalone ecosystem health-check script predating the supervisor; superseded for drift by supervisor.py but retained.

features.name: grant_claude_service_rights.ps1
features.detail: One-off: grant the Claude/service account rights to manage QI_ services. Run-once setup helper.

features.name: patch_mcp_config.py
features.detail: One-off MCP config patcher for ~/.claude.json / MCP server entries.
